glossary.definition: (1) "Powdered or crystalline alcohol" means a product that is manufactured into a powdered or crystalline form and that contains any amount of alcohol.
glossary.source_title: Section 4301.71 - Sale of powdered or crystalline alcohol.

glossary.definition: (2) "Prescription" has the same meaning as in section 4729.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4301.71 - Sale of powdered or crystalline alcohol.

glossary.definition: (3) "Over-the-counter medication" means medication that may be legally sold and purchased without a prescription.
glossary.source_title: Section 4301.71 - Sale of powdered or crystalline alcohol.
